context: Ryosuke and Yumiko sit up late after visiting Hiroshi-elder. They process together.
purpose: married couple processing aging parent — quiet deep mutual support

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、お父さん、今日、すごく弱ってた。
lines.en: Hey, dad — today, seemed very weak.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender careful-honest-warm disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Father warm soft tender deep-matching-warm acknowledgment, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、私と話すの、すごく嬉しそうだった。
lines.en: Dad seemed really happy talking with me.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere tender-observation-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 俺の手も、長く握ってくれてた。
lines.en: He held my hand for a long time too.
lines.style: Father warm soft tender deep-emotional disclosure-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 心配で、今夜眠れないかも。
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender honest vulnerable-warm disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 一緒にいるから。眠れなくても、二人で、起きてようか。
lines.en: I'm with you. Even unable to sleep — let's be awake together.
lines.style: Father warm soft tender deep sincere-supporting-warm offering, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう…亮介と一緒で、本当に良かった。
lines.en: Thank you… being with Ryosuke — truly good.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere deep tender-grateful-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: こちらこそ。お父さん、ゆみこを大事に育ててくれた。
lines.en: Same. Dad raised you with care.
lines.style: Father warm soft tender sincere deep-reflective-warm gratitude, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 感謝、ちゃんと言えてるかな…。
lines.en: I wonder if I'm saying thanks properly…
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender vulnerable worried-warm disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 言えてる。今日も、すごく素敵な時間、過ごせてた。
lines.en: You are. Today too, you spent really lovely time.
lines.style: Father warm soft tender sincere-reassuring-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 気持ち、ちゃんと伝えていきたい。
lines.en: I want to convey my feelings properly.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender sincere-committing-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん。残された時間、大切にしよう。
lines.en: Yes. The remaining time — let's cherish.
lines.style: Father warm soft tender deep sincere-philosophical-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 亮介、本当に、ありがとう。
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender sincere deep closing-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
